reporting-org.narrative: FMO NV (Nederlandse Financierings-Maatschappij voor Ontwikkelingslanden N.V.)

description.narrative: This financing will enable the development, construction and operation of a 10 MW / 20 MWh battery storage facility and 16 MW solar power plant with a total project cost of around EUR 40 million. It will be located in Bokhol, Northern Senegal, near the Senergy 2 solar plant that is also owned by Africa REN and financed by FMO.
